name: Signature Grass-Fed Goat Curry Cut
tagline: Tender bone-in & boneless pieces from young pasture-raised goats
description: Our signature goat curry cut is crafted from young, pasture-raised goats that feed on natural herbal greens. Hand-trimmed by master butchers to give you the perfect balance of tender meat, succulent fat, and bone marrow for deep, flavorful gravies.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours. Keep refrigerated at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep stored in cold refrigeration (0°C - 4°C). Wash gently under cold tap water right before cooking. Do not refreeze once thawed.
feedType: 100% Organic Pasture Grass, Alfalfa & Herbal Forage
culinaryUses: Perfect for traditional Hyderabadi Mutton Curry, Dalcha, Rogan Josh, and slow-braised curries.

name: Royal Goat Biryani Cut (Rich Cuts)
tagline: Large succulent pieces with shoulder, shank & ribs crafted for Dum Biryani
description: Specially cut in larger 40-50g portions featuring prime cuts from shoulder, chops, and marrow shanks. These larger pieces lock in the juices during slow dum cooking, delivering meltingly tender meat that absorbs aromatic saffron and spices.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours. Keep refrigerated at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep chilled at 0°C - 4°C. Marinate with yogurt and spices 2-4 hours prior to cooking for maximum tenderness.
culinaryUses: Formulated specifically for Authentic Hyderabadi Dum Biryani, Mandi, and Pulao.
piecesEstimate: 10 to 14 large biryani cuts per kg

name: Pure Goat Boneless Meat
tagline: 100% pure tender muscle meat, zero bone, trimmed to perfection
description: Ultra-lean yet juicy boneless goat meat carved from the leg and shoulder. Cleaned thoroughly, membrane-trimmed, and ready for gourmet cooking without any bone wastage.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate at 0-4°C. Ideal for mincing or dicing into bite-sized tikka cubes.
culinaryUses: Sensational for Mutton Tikka, Boti Kebab, Mutton Sukka, and Kashmiri Rogan Josh.
piecesEstimate: 100% edible meat, 25-30 bite sized chunks per 500g

name: Fresh Goat Mince (Fine Keema)
tagline: Finely ground fresh goat meat with optimum lean-to-fat balance
description: Double-minced fresh goat meat with just the right 85:15 lean-to-natural fat ratio for juicy kebabs and rich keema curries. Freshly ground upon order, never frozen or pre-packaged.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 24-36 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep stored in cold chiller. Use immediately after opening.
culinaryUses: Shami Kebabs, Keema Pav, Seekh Kebabs, and Keema Matar.

name: Goat Chops & Ribs (Chaap)
tagline: Tender rib bones with prime meat, ideal for pan-searing & tandoor
description: Prime French-trimmed rib chops with rich marbling. Sourced from young goats to ensure supreme tenderness when grilled, pan-roasted, or spiced for dry fry.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Store at 0°C - 4°C. Marinate with ginger-garlic and freshly crushed peppercorns.
culinaryUses: Mutton Chaap Fry, Tandoori Chops, Grilled Ribs, and Shahi Korma.

name: Cleaned Goat Paya (Trotters)
tagline: Flame-scorched, de-haired and thoroughly scraped clean trotters
description: Traditional flame-roasted trotters, scraped immaculately clean and portioned into neat roundels. Rich in natural gelatin, collagen, and bone marrow for restorative broths and Hyderabadi Paya Shorba.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate at 0-4°C. Simmer slowly on low flame with whole spices for 3-4 hours.
culinaryUses: Authentic Hyderabadi Mutton Paya Shorba, Nihari, and bone marrow broth.

name: Country Chicken (Original Natukodi)
tagline: 100% Free-Range country fowls raised on open fields with earthy rich aroma
description: Authentic desi country chicken raised in open sunlit pastures feeding on green grasses, seeds, and insects. Characterized by lean, firm, flavorful red meat that cooks into an intensely aromatic, spicy village-style curry.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep chilled at 0°C - 4°C. Pressure cook or slow simmer for tender fall-off-the-bone texture.
culinaryUses: Natukodi Pulusu, Andhra Country Chicken Curry, Country Chicken Fry with steamed rice.
piecesEstimate: 14 to 18 curry cut pieces per kg

name: Farm Tender Chicken Curry Cut
tagline: Juicy bone-in & boneless pieces from tender young farm chicken
description: Sourced from young farm-raised chickens fed with vegetarian grain diets and probiotic water. Cleaned in RO water, skinned, and trimmed with zero slime or excess fat.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Store at 0°C to 4°C. Wash gently with cold water before seasoning.
culinaryUses: Butter Chicken, Chicken Masala, Korma, and Chicken Biryani.

name: Fresh Boneless Chicken Breast Fillet
tagline: High-protein lean fillets, tenderized and trimmed of all visible fat
description: Pure prime whole chicken breast fillets with zero bones and minimal fat. Packed with 25g+ lean protein per 100g, perfect for fitness enthusiasts and gourmet grilling.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate at 0°C - 4°C. Slice across grain or pound lightly for extra softness.
culinaryUses: Grilled Chicken, Pasta, Tikka, Meal Prep, and Crispy Chicken Strips.

name: Juicy Chicken Drumsticks (Tangdi)
tagline: Tender, skinless chicken legs perfect for tandoori and juicy fries
description: Selected plump chicken drumsticks with skin removed and cleanly trimmed at the bone joints. Meat stays exceptionally moist and juicy whether roasted, baked, or fried.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep chilled at 0-4°C. Make light surface slits before marinating.
culinaryUses: Tangdi Kebab, Fried Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, and Drumstick Masala.

name: Pasture-Raised Country Brown Eggs (Desi Gaddi Guddu)
tagline: Organic eggs from free-roaming country hens with dark golden yolks
description: Laid by native country hens foraging freely in sunshine and pasture. Naturally abundant in Omega-3, lutein, and bioavailable vitamins. Noted for their rich creamy texture and deep orange-gold yolks.
shelfLife: Best before 21 days from harvest date. Store in cool, dry place or refrigerate.
storageInstructions: Store with pointed end down in refrigerator at 4°C - 8°C for optimal freshness.
culinaryUses: Half-boiled, sunny side up, poached eggs, egg bhurji, and baking.

name: Kadaknath Heritage Black Fowl Eggs
tagline: Rare Ayurvedic heritage eggs known for maximum iron, protein & low cholesterol
description: Produced by authentic purebred Kadaknath black fowls. Highly revered in traditional wellness for superior protein content, amino acids, high iron, and low cholesterol content.
shelfLife: Best before 21 days from harvest date. Keep in cool ventilated place.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate at 4°C - 8°C. Do not wash shells until ready to cook.
culinaryUses: Boiled eggs, omelettes, nutritious breakfast tonic bowls.

name: Classic Farm Fresh Table Eggs
tagline: Daily morning gathered white eggs, clean shells & high freshness
description: Hygienically collected from healthy farm hens fed with mineral-enriched corn and grain feeds. Graded, sanitized, and delivered within 24 hours of laying.
shelfLife: Best before 25 days from packing date.
storageInstructions: Store in clean refrigerator tray. Use for daily baking & cooking.
culinaryUses: Baking cakes, daily omelettes, French toast, scrambled eggs.

name: Sunday Feast Combo: Tender Goat (1kg) + Country Chicken (1kg)
tagline: The ultimate weekend meat combo with maximum freshness & savings
description: Double the feast on your dining table! Includes 1 kg of our signature grass-fed Goat Curry Cut + 1 kg of authentic Free-Range Country Chicken (Natukodi). Specially packed in insulated chill boxes.
shelfLife: Best consumed within 48 hours at 0°C to 4°C.
storageInstructions: Keep stored chilled between 0°C and 4°C until cooking.
culinaryUses: Weekend Family Biryani, Sunday Feast curries, and gatherings.
